precision.baseline: Unmodified E17A CLASS defaults, verified N_native=81, no original or archived E17A rewrite
precision.note: Both tiers change only CLASS numerical k sampling, not physical parameters, frozen source, redshift, shape or cosmology. Recompute fresh mPk,dTk,vTk for each frozen state; explicitly record actual native grid size and bounds. No artificial interpolation beyond actual native CLASS k support.
precision.evaluations: For both short legs of exactly E16 576 orientations at three frozen z, compare E17A native-grid linear t_ncdm[0]-t_cdm and Newtonian delta_cb against tier-high and tier-ultra direct CLASS transfer grids, plus fresh pk_cb_lin at exact |ki|. Keep original E13 R16 wind rank separate; never substitute short-mode theta for R16 wind.
precision.scaled_error: |x-y|/max(|x|,|y|,10^-6 * max_abs_ultra_native_transfer_over_fixed_legs_and_z_for_state_and_field); retain raw absolute and relative gaps and worst geometries; measure baseline/high and high/ultra separately.
precision.audit: Store complete actual high and ultra CLASS k grids and t_ncdm[0],t_cdm,d_b,d_cdm arrays at each of three z and each state. Independently reconstruct all leg/z interpolated transfers from archived native arrays, verify exact original E17A per-row SHA, triangle order and Pcb direct values, and report maximum scaled gaps without importing E17B worker.

prereg_engineering_diagnostics_NOT_physi.qualification: Passing these diagnostics supports sampled linear numerical stability on the frozen grid. It is not a mathematically certified truncation error and does not validate a physical retarded halo response.

outputs: Fresh three-state high/ultra CLASS native transfer and direct leg Pcb comparisons with numeric status recorded even when a prereg QA fails.
Independent standard-library native-array interpolation replay and frozen E17A SHA gate.
Original report, independent replay, complete SHA manifest committed permanently to source_data on audit branch; update draft PR and master plan only after reviewing CI.
